mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (u_id, inquiry_type, title, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uId}, #{inquiryType}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT inquiry_id, u_id, inquiry_type, title, content, inquiry_status, created_at, updated_at FROM inquiry WHERE u_id = #{uId} ORDER BY inquiry_id
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET inquiry_type = #{inquiryType}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND u_id = #{uId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM inquiry WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND u_id = #{uId}
